# BillingMeterStanding

How much of one allowance a tenant has used this billing period, in the meter's base unit.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `meter` | [`BillingMeter`](billing-meter.md) |  |
| `used` | `number` | Used so far this period (seconds, GiB-seconds, search pages or fetch units). |
| `allowance` | `number \| null` | What the plan includes this period; null when unlimited. |

## Example

```json
{
  "meter": "Standard",
  "used": 0,
  "allowance": 0
}
```

## Where it's used

- Inside [`BillingStanding`](billing-standing.md)
